notice.noteAddedFloor: Office note added: the tablets of this work order read it too.
notice.emailQueued: The mail is on its way: its delivery word shows on the message.
notice.linkCopied: Link copied: it opens this record with the message open.
notice.linkFailed: The link could not be copied: this browser does not allow it here.
notice.statusConflict: Someone changed the thread meanwhile: it was read again. Try again.
notice.forbidden: You may not do this here.
notice.openFailed: The file could not be opened. Try again.
notice.partyUnread: The customer’s contacts could not be read: type the address yourself.
notice.cannotOpen: One file you cannot open: it is out of your reach (its record, or a measurement sheet without the right to open it).
notice.copied: Copied to {target}: the copy names where it came from.
notice.portalPosted: Posted in the portal: the customer reads it there; their mail setting decides when they hear of it.
notice.floorPrice: Not added: “{found}” looks like a price, and the floor never sees money. Take it out, or write it as an office note’s amount. Your text is back in the box.
notice.taskFromMessage: Task made: it links back to this message.

portal.NO_PARTY: Not posted: this record has no customer yet (a prospect has no portal). Make the customer first; your text is back in the box.
portal.NO_PORTAL: Not posted: nobody of this customer reads this record in the portal now. Reply by e-mail instead; your text is back in the box.
portal.CLOSED: Not posted: this thread is closed. Reopen it to reply; your text is back in the box.
portal.NOT_SHAREABLE: Not posted: this record’s thread stays inside the factory and is never shared with a customer. Write an office note; your text is back in the box.
portal.other: Not posted in the portal: the factory refused it as it is. Your text is back in the box.

notice.pinned: Pinned for everyone on this record.
notice.unpinned: Unpinned: the message stays in the thread.

pin.HELD: A mail still in its 10 seconds to take it back, or taken back, is not pinned.
pin.FULL: This conversation already has 50 pinned messages: unpin one first.
pin.forbidden: Pinning needs the right to write on this conversation.
pin.gone: That message is no longer in this conversation.
pin.failed: The pin could not be changed. Try again.

notice.messageGone: That message is no longer in this conversation, or it is out of your reach.
notice.done: Marked done. It opens again by itself when a new message arrives.
notice.openAgain: Open again: the thread is back in the work lists.
notice.doneFailed: Done could not be changed. Try again.
